story_policy.role: Bridge from CWA wrapper lineage to publishable product story candidates.
story_policy.story_gate: A product can have a source-attributable package journey before it has a verified ingredient journey.

story_policy.image_gate: External CWA images remain link-only unless rights review clears publication.
